parts.text: Fig. 6.1 shows an object O which is 5.0 cm away from the centre of a thin, converging lens L. The focal length of L is 3.0 cm. Fig. 6.1 is drawn to full scale. Fig. 6.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) On Fig. 6.1, label the principal axis with a P. [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) On Fig. 6.1, place a letter X at a focal point. [1]

ms.label: 6(a)(ii)
ms.text: X on horizontal axis 3.0 cm to the left of centre of L OR X on horizontal axis 3.0 cm to the right of centre of L

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) On Fig. 6.1, draw two rays from O to locate the tip of the image produced by the lens. [2]

ms.label: 6(a)(iii)
ms.text:
Any two from:
•
Straight line from a point on O, passing through centre of L (and beyond)
•
Horizontal line from same point on O to L, refracted through F (on RH side of L)
•
Straight line from same point on O through F (on LH side of L) to L, refracted parallel to principal axis
both rays extended until they intersect
